items.title: Apple gains smartphone share as memory crunch squeezes budget Android phones
items.summary: Apple's share of US smartphone shipments jumped to 57% in the third quarter from 50% a year earlier as rising memory costs squeezed makers of budget Android phones, according to Counterpoint Research.
